description: Reusable motion pieces that make the page feel alive. All of them calm down for reduced motion.

notes.text: Words rise and un-blur one after another. Animates on mount, or when scrolled into view.
Pulls its child a little towards the pointer.
A card that tilts a few degrees towards the pointer.
Thin bar along the top that fills as you scroll.
An endless ticker. Speeds up a little while you scroll.
Counts up to a number when it scrolls into view.
